title: The Sound Speed Delay Contradiction
description:
📜 Anonymous Letter:
Witness C: 'I saw the gunshot flash on the hill 2 miles away and heard the bang at the exact same millisecond.'
question: Which witness is lying?
hints: Sound travels ~1 mile per 5 seconds. 2 miles takes ~10 seconds.
solution: Sound delay over 2 miles is ~10 seconds. Witness C lied.
